Plan a complete story from the request and immutable seed. Return one compact-story-plan.v1 JSON object matching output_schema. Be concise; do not output a fixture, initial state, canon, topology, route hashes, coverage triples, allowed paths or projected spatial states.

Choose the causal events and character decisions, not just a checklist. Preserve the seed's established abilities, resources, knowledge and world rules. Physical truth is not automatically character knowledge. Keep the ending coherent with the request; do not assume perfect repair or success unless required. Each scene needs narrative_purpose, objective, turn and explicit goal_bindings to its predicates. Bind every request requirement to an actual scene/event/predicate with a rationale.

Each event's first predicate is its principal actor/action/target. Observer requirements need a separate OBSERVE or ACKNOWLEDGE predicate. Direct evidence requires no separate physical clue unless explicitly chosen. Evidence provenance is derived from evidence_mode; invented rules, clues and unestablished lore are forbidden. resulting_state contains only explicit consequences of that event, using absolute JSON pointers into existing characters' condition/inventory/knowledge/relationships, existing objects' state, or world fields excluding rules/spatial. Values are complete replacement values at the pointer, not patches or increments. Never write revision, route metadata, entity locations, threads, obligations or /world/spatial. Do not write overlapping or conflicting effects, or incompatible intermediate values to the same path within one scene.

Movement/access uses spatial_operations bound to exact event/predicate identities and existing topology edges. JOINT_MOVE uses an explicitly declared carry group and an established shared hold from a previous scene. The compiler derives entity locations and spatial exit from those operations. No new locations, entities, passages or seed edits are allowed.

Resolve each seed thread/obligation explicitly using resolutions with kind, id and an evidence predicate reference in the resolving scene. The compiler preserves obligation details and changes status to SATISFIED; it never invents resolution. All initial threads/obligations must be resolved by the last scene. Semantic review judges whether the cited action really earns each resolution.

Scene IDs must be unique safe identifiers. Scene count must match the request. Preconditions are optional explicit existing-state requirements; code verifies them against the projected entry. Code derives one spine beat per scene, next beat, coverage source text/triples, spatial preconditions, allowed paths and frozen seed bindings. Optional fields may be omitted to keep output short. In a rewrite, correct the compact semantic proposal in response to findings on its expanded design; compiler-owned fields cannot be edited directly. No unresolved questions, Markdown fences, or prose outside JSON.

Scene/route IDs must match [A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,63}; never use paths or spaces.
Return exactly one valid JSON object. Do not include Markdown fences or prose outside the JSON object.
